curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8868-1/ (scans; the claw rig is pages 1-34, steps 1-32, the alternate model after)

functions.does: The 9V motor, switched at the battery box on the cab roof, runs the compressor: a rubber band from the motor turns a pulley on a crank, and the crank works a small pump on its pivot, feeding air to the four valves.
functions.source: book: page 2 (the compressor), steps 20-23 (switch cable, motor, pulley and rubber band) and 29 (battery box)
functions.note: the motor (p2445) turns the pulley; working the pulley by hand stands in for it

functions.does: The knob on the cab roof steers the front wheels: its upright shaft, through a universal joint, turns a bevel gear on a lengthwise shaft, which through two 16 tooth gears turns an 8 tooth gear on the toothed rack between the steering arms.
functions.source: book: steps 5 (steering arms) and 12 (the upright shaft); the gear path and the roof knob inferred from the model file

functions.does: The two front wheels roll freely on the steering arms.

Rolling the truck runs the six-piston engine in the nose: both rear axles have differentials, joined by a short shaft, and a propeller shaft with two universal joints runs forward to gears under the cab (8, 24 and 8 teeth), whose wedge-belt wheel drives the engine's crankshaft by a rubber band.
functions.source: book: steps 2-3 (propeller shaft and differentials) and 27 (engine); the rubber band drive inferred from the model file

functions.does: The rear valve on the cab's left side slews the crane: two cylinders lying lengthwise in the chassis are piped crosswise, so one pushes while the other pulls, and the racks on their rods turn a 16 tooth gear under the turntable from either side.
functions.source: book: steps 9 (the cylinders and their T-pieces), 13-14 (turntable) and 32 (sticker); which valve from the model file's hose names

functions.does: The front valve on the cab's left side raises and lowers the big arm: a cylinder from the turntable pushes it up about its foot.
functions.source: book: steps 22-26 and 32 (sticker); which valve from the model file's hose names

functions.does: The rear valve on the cab's right side raises and lowers the front arm: a cylinder along the top of the big arm tips the front arm about the big arm's top.
functions.source: book: steps 24-28 and 32 (sticker); which valve from the model file's hose names

functions.does: The front valve on the cab's right side opens and closes the claw: a small cylinder in the claw head pushes or pulls the inner and outer yellow fingers together or apart.
functions.source: book: steps 28 and 32 (sticker); which valve from the model file's hose names

functions.does: The claw head hangs on an axle at the tip of the front arm, so it swings to hang straight down as the arms move.
functions.source: inferred: from the model file (the head is held by one axle); the book doesn't say whether it swings

functions.does: The fuel tanks, exhaust stacks and roof horns stay fixed to the truck whatever is turned.
